changelog: **zod 4 deprecations, part 1 (#3568):** every `parsed.error.flatten()` (91 sites) is now `z.flattenError(parsed.error)` and `ZodTypeAny` is `ZodType` — the zod 4 forms of the same calls (`flatten()` delegates to `flattenError()`, and `ZodTypeAny` is a plain alias). No response shape changes.
